overview: The Divider is a styled HTML `<hr>` element used to visually separate sections of content, rendering as a thin horizontal line. Prefer semantic section structure or spacing utilities when a visual separator is not strictly needed.

whenToUse: Between logically distinct sections of a page or form
As a lightweight visual cue when additional whitespace alone is insufficient
do: Use the default (primary) variant for general-purpose separation
Use the branded variant sparingly to draw attention to a meaningful section boundary
dont: Use a divider as a substitute for proper heading hierarchy or spacing
Stack multiple dividers in close proximity
